schema_notes: Each entry describes one sample game for the picker. Required: id, title, description, pgn_path (relative to src/static/samples/). Optional: group (picker section heading), time_control, white_rating, black_rating (display-only, usually from the PGN headers). Optional fields for thesis-corpus provenance: source ('test partition' or 'synthetic corpus'), selection_label (one of 'best-predicted', 'typical', 'worst-predicted', 'synthetic: caught', 'synthetic: false alarm', 'synthetic: missed'), white_test_error / black_test_error (this game's held-out test MAE in rating points, per side, as measured during thesis evaluation), white_actual_rating / black_actual_rating (ground-truth rating used for evaluation, which may differ from any PGN Elo header). substituted_plies (array of 1-indexed plies) marks engine-substituted moves for a synthetic-corpus game as ground truth on the board, move list, and chart; leave empty for a real game. Synthetic-corpus-only: substitution_rate, maia_band, engine, s_att_eval (the suspicion score recorded during thesis evaluation, to compare against this app's own computed score).
